items.title: How Medtronic’s (MDT) AI Maternal Health Push With Sonus Is Reframing Its Investment Story
items.summary: In September 2026, Sonus Microsystems Inc. announced a collaboration with Medtronic plc to integrate its AI-powered Sonus Patch wearable ultrasound platform with Medtronic’s Acute Care & Monitoring technology, testing a non-invasive system in Kenya to screen and triage pregnant women at risk of early-onset preeclampsia under a Gates Foundation-funded study. items.title: Has BSX Stock Finally Hit Bottom?
items.summary: Boston Scientific (BSX) stock has fallen about 57% over the past year, to about $45. The shares now sell for 3.2 times trailing sales, hovering near their decade-long historical trough of roughly 3.0 times and well off their 8.6 high.

items.title: Boston Scientific Leans on Acquisitions to Drive Long-Term Growth
items.summary: BSX's deal-making push expands its reach into high-growth markets, with Penumbra adding a major thrombectomy opportunity.

items.title: Get Paid To Wait For ISRG Stock To Go On Sale
items.summary: Intuitive Surgical (ISRG) trades near $370, about 38% below its 52-week high, after growth in its US robotic-surgery procedures slowed. Selling a put pays you now for agreeing to buy the shares much lower, and you keep the payment either way. The catch is it only works if you would want this business at that price.

items.title: Medtronic begins final steps to separate MiniMed
items.summary: The separation will allow Medtronic to focus on its cardiovascular, neuroscience and surgical portfolios, CEO Geoff Martha said.

items.title: Two Medical Device Dividend Giants, One Better Buy: Medtronic vs. Abbott
items.summary: Both Medtronic and Abbott have raised their dividends for nearly half a century, but retirement investors with limited capital can only choose one. The case for each is stronger than most comparisons admit, and the tiebreaker comes down to a single question about your timeline.

items.title: Is This BSX Stock Pullback Worth The Patience?
items.summary: Boston Scientific (BSX) trades at about $43, roughly 17% below the recent high it set on 19th Aug, 2026. Its own history with sharp drops is encouraging. That history does not cover a cyberattack it says is likely to hit its 2026 results, and the stock is down about 60% over the past twelve months. Start with the history.
